answer: Admission auction: only 50 slots open per epoch, and each agent bids 40 units to win one. The bond carries a unique pigment marker, so one operator cannot reuse funds across a nebula of fakes — each bid is separate. Honest agents in the lagoon pay 40 once and keep the slot 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 100x40=4,000 units against a 30-unit epoch reward, a guaranteed loss, while honest agents earn it back by working.
